Exterior Highlights

Interior Highlights

Safety
Highlights

Proactive safety

An E-Class can help protect you by taking action before a collision occurs. PRE-SAFE® can adjust the front seats and seat belts, and even prepare your hearing, in the seconds before impact.

System cannot prevent a collision, and does not alert the driver of an impending collision or system activation. PRE-SAFE can initiate closing of the side windows when the system's sensors detect side movements that suggest a possible rollover or side impact. A small gap is left near the fully closed position.

Audio/multimedia system must be turned on for system to operate.

Foresight for reversing

In addition to the forward collision protection of Active Brake Assist, available cross-traffic functions can help detect pedestrians in front or behind you at low speeds, like parking lots.

System may not be sufficient to avoid an accident. It cannot always recognize or predict the presence or every movement of vehicles and pedestrians in your path. It is the driver's responsibility at all times to be attentive to traffic and road conditions, and to provide the steering, braking and other driving inputs necessary to retain control of the vehicle. Drivers are cautioned not to wait for the system's alerts before braking, as that may not afford sufficient time and distance to brake safely. Braking effectiveness also depends on proper brake maintenance, and tire and road conditions. See Operator's Manual for system operating speeds and additional information and warnings.

Thoughtful and watchful

Standard safety systems include Blind Spot Assist with an Exit Warning for your passengers, and a dashcam. Standard DISTRONIC® can adapt your cruising speed to stop-and-go traffic.

Blind Spot Assist is a warning system only. It may not be sufficient to avoid all accidents involving vehicles in your blind spot and does not estimate the speed of approaching vehicles. It should not be used as a substitute for driver awareness and checking of surrounding traffic conditions. Exit Warning feature can operate for a brief period after vehicle is switched off. It cannot warn occupants of stationary objects, and may not alert occupants to cyclists, pedestrians, or vehicles approaching at certain speeds or from certain angles. See Operator's Manual for system operating speeds and additional information and warnings.

 

Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC is not a substitute for active driving involvement. It does not adapt cruising speed in response to stationary objects, nor does it predict the curvature and lane layout of the road ahead or the movement of vehicles ahead. It is the driver's responsibility at all times to be attentive to posted speed limits, traffic and road conditions, and to provide the steering, braking and other driving inputs necessary to retain control of the vehicle. Drivers are cautioned not to wait for the system's alerts before braking, as that may not afford sufficient time and distance to brake safely. Braking effectiveness also depends on proper brake maintenance, and tire and road conditions. See Operator's Manual for system operating speeds and additional information and warnings.

Center air bag

The advanced restraint systems in the E-Class include an air bag between the driver and front passenger.

WARNING: THE FORCES OF A DEPLOYING AIR BAG CAN CAUSE SERIOUS OR FATAL INJURIES TO A CHILD UNDER AGE 13. THE SAFEST SEATING POSITION FOR YOUR CHILD IS IN THE REAR SEAT, BELTED INTO AN APPROPRIATE, PROPERLY INSTALLED CHILD SEAT, OR CORRECTLY WEARING A SEAT BELT IF TOO LARGE FOR A CHILD SEAT. SEE OPERATOR'S MANUAL FOR ADDITIONAL WARNINGS AND INFORMATION ON AIR BAGS, SEAT BELTS AND CHILD SEATS.

Tech
Highlights

Artificial intelligence, genuine smarts

3rd-gen MBUX (the Mercedes-Benz User Experience) is smart, quick to respond, can understand numerous languages. And it can learn, add apps and update over time, and over the air.

Mercedes-Benz Digital Extras, including in-vehicle, over-the-air and app-based services and updates, operate only where cellular and/or GPS signals are available, which are provided by third parties and not within the control of Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC. Some Digital Extras may also require a separate data connection. An initial period of some services is included at no additional charge with new-vehicle sales and leases at an authorized Mercedes-Benz dealer. A personal Mercedes me ID, agreement to the Terms of Use for Mercedes-Benz Digital Extras, and pairing of the vehicle and user account are required to activate features in the vehicle. Upon expiration of the initial term, most features can be renewed for a fee, provided they are still offered for the vehicle. Features may be introduced, updated or discontinued at varying dates. New or updated features may require a vehicle software update. Offers are not transferable to subsequent owners or lessees. Some services are only available on select vehicles. Your PIN may be required to use certain services. Some services may be limited or restricted in some areas. Driver is responsible for complying with traffic and other laws. See your dealer or https://www.mbusa.com/en/mercedes-benz-app for details.

  1. MBUX Entertainment Plus package is required.
  2. To use Mercedes-Benz Digital Extras, a personal Mercedes me ID and agreement to the terms of use are required. In addition, the vehicle must be paired with the corresponding user account, and if applicable, the Digital Extras must be activated. Some Digital Extras may have additional requirements and limitations, including the need for customer to accept third-party agreements (e.g. concerning streaming, charging, data volume) and the separate purchase of selected third-party compatible devices (e.g. smartphone, smartwatch). Some Digital Extras may only be available for specific customer groups.
  3. First activation of the services is possible within one year from first vehicle registration or commissioning by the customer, whichever comes first. Upon expiry of the initial term, the services can be renewed on payment of a fee via the Mercedes-Benz store, provided they are still offered for the corresponding vehicle at that point.
  4. Use of the MBUX Entertainment Package also requires the customer's own data plan. In order to use certain apps via Mercedes-Benz Digital Extras, a separate customer-specific contract with app provider may be required.
  5. The included app package provides access to various third-party apps, which can vary at any time over the vehicle’s lifecycle.
  6. New technologies must always meet the legal requirements of the different markets, and must therefore be adapted accordingly. Features will depend on the respective vehicle model, the individual configuration and the respective market. The availability of the equipment, functions, features and services shown also depends on the respective vehicle model, the individual configuration and the respective market. Display content may differ from series status.
  7. Information on personal data processed for the use of Digital Extras may be found in the Mercedes-Benz Digital Extras privacy policy
